scope: Prior art overlapping exact-generated arbitrary-order finite-difference WENO in maintainable differentiable ordinary PyTorch, characteristic systems through WENO-15, and competitive CPU/GPU execution without bespoke canonical accelerator kernels.

searches.notes: All returned title/DOI metadata screened; many false positives used WENO as an unrelated acronym.
First 100 relevance-ranked records screened. The query is noisy because metadata search does not preserve Boolean field semantics.

searches.notes: All returned metadata screened. Publisher and arXiv searches added JAX-Shock, which this query missed.

searches.query: finite difference WENO GPU CUDA accelerator
searches.notes: All returned metadata screened and supplemented from included-paper citations.

searches.query: finite difference WENO arbitrary order symbolic generated generation
searches.notes: All returned metadata screened; OpenSBLI and the Jiang-Shu lineage were retained.

No metadata hit; official compiler sources and JAX-based systems were screened separately. This is not evidence of absence.

searches.notes: All returned metadata screened; JAX-Fluids primary paper and source were retained.

searches.notes: The all-name metadata query was too restrictive; each named project was searched and inspected directly.

searches.query: query.bibliographic adaptations of the frozen families
searches.notes: Four relevance-ranked 100-record pages were screened. Crossref returned extremely broad matches; the remaining six calls were HTTP 429 rate-limited and are recorded as unavailable rather than covered.
Public API returned HTTP 429 on 2026-08-27. Primary arXiv, publisher, and official-project sources were used instead.

searches.query: Frozen families, submitted in three search batches with exact phrases where supported
searches.endpoint: publisher, arXiv, NASA NTRS, and official project pages recorded in studies.json
searches.notes: Discovery results were screened, then positive feature claims were checked against primary papers, official documentation, or inspected official source. Search snippets were not used as feature evidence.

searches.query: pytorch weno; torch weno finite difference; jax weno; arbitrary order weno generator; weno cuda
searches.notes: Plausible repositories were checked through official repository pages; acronym collisions and projects lacking relevant solver evidence were excluded with reasons.
Energy Stable WENO Schemes of Arbitrary Order retained as mathematical lineage, not a matching software system.

searches.query: References and citing/discovery records from Jiang-Shu, PyClaw/PyWENO, OpenSBLI, JAX-Fluids, HOPE, and GPU FD-WENO entries
searches.endpoint: primary papers and indexed citing records
searches.notes: One complete pass added no study that changed a C0-C5 claim status after OpenSBLI, PyWENO/PyClaw, JAX-Fluids, HOPE, JAX-Shock, and the GPU systems were classified.

coverage_limitations: Scopus and Web of Science were not available.
Crossref and Semantic Scholar public APIs rate-limited part of the protocol.
Only the first 100 relevance-ranked results of noisy OpenAlex family S2 were screened.
The review is systematic and reproducible but not a proof that no unindexed or unpublished implementation exists.
Very recent 2026 software may not yet have archival papers or stable interfaces.
No external subject-matter reviewer has independently audited the classification yet.
